problems.name: dialect translation
problems.passage: We study dialect translation from Algerian Arabic to English using mBART and back-translation.

methods.name: mBART
methods.passage: We fine-tune mBART on a small parallel corpus of Algerian Arabic.

methods.name: back-translation
methods.passage: We then add back-translated data generated from monolingual dialect text.

datasets.name: MADAR
datasets.passage: We evaluate on the MADAR dataset with chrF.

contexts.name: Algerian Arabic
contexts.passage: We study dialect translation from Algerian Arabic to English using mBART and back-translation.
